    static class TaskF {
        int n;
        char[] s;
        int[] ugliness;

        public void solve(int testNumber, InputReader in, PrintWriter out) {
            n = in.readInt();
            s = in.readString().toCharArray();
            ugliness = new int[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                ugliness[i] = -in.readInt();
            }

            int V = 1 + 26 + n / 2 + 1;
            MinCostFlow mcf = new MinCostFlow(V);
            for (char c = 'a'; c <= 'z'; ++c) {
                for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; ++i) {
                    int cost = 0;
                    if (c == s[i]) {
                        cost = Math.min(cost, ugliness[i]);
                    }
                    if (c == s[n - 1 - i]) {
                        cost = Math.min(cost, ugliness[n - 1 - i]);
                    }
                    mcf.addEdge(1 + (c - 'a'), 1 + 26 + i, 1, cost);
                }
            }

            int[] occurs = new int[128];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) occurs[s[i]]++;
            for (char c = 'a'; c <= 'z'; ++c) {
                mcf.addEdge(0, 1 + (c - 'a'), occurs[c], 0);
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; ++i) {
                mcf.addEdge(1 + 26 + i, 1 + 26 + n / 2, 2, 0);
            }

            long[] result = mcf.minCostMaxFlow(0, 1 + 26 + n / 2, n);
            out.println(-result[0]);
        }
    }

    static class MinCostFlow {
        static class Edge {
            int to, rev;
            long cap, cost;
            Edge(int to, int rev, long cap, long cost) {
                this.to = to;
                this.rev = rev;
                this.cap = cap;
                this.cost = cost;
            }
        }

        List<Edge>[] g;
        long[] h, dist;
        int[] prevv, preve;

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        MinCostFlow(int n) {
            g = new List[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            h = new long[n];
            dist = new long[n];
            prevv = new int[n];
            preve = new int[n];
        }

        void addEdge(int from, int to, long cap, long cost) {
            g[from].add(new Edge(to, g[to].size(), cap, cost));
            g[to].add(new Edge(from, g[from].size() - 1, 0, -cost));
        }

        long[] minCostMaxFlow(int s, int t, long maxf) {
            long flow = 0, cost = 0;
            Arrays.fill(h, 0);
            while (flow < maxf) {
                Arrays.fill(dist, Long.MAX_VALUE);
                dist[s] = 0;
                // Use a simple array-based priority queue (binary heap) instead of Java's PriorityQueue
                int[] heap = new int[g.length];
                long[] heapDist = new long[g.length];
                int heapSize = 0;
                int[] pos = new int[g.length];
                Arrays.fill(pos, -1);
                heap[heapSize] = s;
                heapDist[heapSize] = 0;
                pos[s] = heapSize;
                heapSize++;
                while (heapSize > 0) {
                    int u = heap[0];
                    long du = heapDist[0];
                    // remove min
                    heapSize--;
                    heap[0] = heap[heapSize];
                    heapDist[0] = heapDist[heapSize];
                    pos[heap[0]] = 0;
                    // sift down
                    int idx = 0;
                    while (true) {
                        int left = 2 * idx + 1;
                        int right = 2 * idx + 2;
                        int smallest = idx;
                        if (left < heapSize && heapDist[left] < heapDist[smallest]) smallest = left;
                        if (right < heapSize && heapDist[right] < heapDist[smallest]) smallest = right;
                        if (smallest == idx) break;
                        // swap
                        int tmp = heap[idx];
                        heap[idx] = heap[smallest];
                        heap[smallest] = tmp;
                        long tmpd = heapDist[idx];
                        heapDist[idx] = heapDist[smallest];
                        heapDist[smallest] = tmpd;
                        pos[heap[idx]] = idx;
                        pos[heap[smallest]] = smallest;
                        idx = smallest;
                    }
                    if (du != dist[u]) continue; // outdated
                    for (int i = 0; i < g[u].size(); i++) {
                        Edge e = g[u].get(i);
                        if (e.cap > 0) {
                            int v = e.to;
                            long nd = dist[u] + e.cost + h[u] - h[v];
                            if (dist[v] > nd) {
                                dist[v] = nd;
                                prevv[v] = u;
                                preve[v] = i;
                                if (pos[v] == -1) {
                                    // add to heap
                                    heap[heapSize] = v;
                                    heapDist[heapSize] = nd;
                                    pos[v] = heapSize;
                                    heapSize++;
                                    // sift up
                                    int cur = heapSize - 1;
                                    while (cur > 0) {
                                        int parent = (cur - 1) / 2;
                                        if (heapDist[parent] <= heapDist[cur]) break;
                                        // swap
                                        int tmp = heap[cur];
                                        heap[cur] = heap[parent];
                                        heap[parent] = tmp;
                                        long tmpd = heapDist[cur];
                                        heapDist[cur] = heapDist[parent];
                                        heapDist[parent] = tmpd;
                                        pos[heap[cur]] = cur;
                                        pos[heap[parent]] = parent;
                                        cur = parent;
                                    }
                                } else {
                                    // update
                                    int cur = pos[v];
                                    heapDist[cur] = nd;
                                    while (cur > 0) {
                                        int parent = (cur - 1) / 2;
                                        if (heapDist[parent] <= heapDist[cur]) break;
                                        int tmp = heap[cur];
                                        heap[cur] = heap[parent];
                                        heap[parent] = tmp;
                                        long tmpd = heapDist[cur];
                                        heapDist[cur] = heapDist[parent];
                                        heapDist[parent] = tmpd;
                                        pos[heap[cur]] = cur;
                                        pos[heap[parent]] = parent;
                                        cur = parent;
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (dist[t] == Long.MAX_VALUE) break;
                for (int v = 0; v < g.length; v++) {
                    if (dist[v] < Long.MAX_VALUE) h[v] += dist[v];
                }
                long d = maxf - flow;
                for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevv[v]) {
                    d = Math.min(d, g[prevv[v]].get(preve[v]).cap);
                }
                flow += d;
                cost += d * h[t];
                for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevv[v]) {
                    Edge e = g[prevv[v]].get(preve[v]);
                    e.cap -= d;
                    g[v].get(e.rev).cap += d;
                }
            }
            return new long[]{cost, flow};
        }
    }

    static class InputReader {
        private InputStream stream;
        private byte[] buf = new byte[1024];
        private int curChar;
        private int numChars;
        private SpaceCharFilter filter;

        public InputReader(InputStream stream) {
            this.stream = stream;
        }

        public int read() {
            if (numChars == -1) throw new InputMismatchException();
            if (curChar >= numChars) {
                curChar = 0;
                try {
                    numChars = stream.read(buf);
                } catch (IOException e) {
                    throw new InputMismatchException();
                }
                if (numChars <= 0) return -1;
            }
            return buf[curChar++];
        }

        public int readInt() {
            int c = read();
            while (isSpaceChar(c)) c = read();
            int sgn = 1;
            if (c == '-') { sgn = -1; c = read(); }
            int res = 0;
            do {
                if (c < '0' || c > '9') throw new InputMismatchException();
                res *= 10;
                res += c - '0';
                c = read();
            } while (!isSpaceChar(c));
            return res * sgn;
        }

        public String readString() {
            int c = read();
            while (isSpaceChar(c)) c = read();
            StringBuilder res = new StringBuilder();
            do {
                if (Character.isValidCodePoint(c)) res.appendCodePoint(c);
                c = read();
            } while (!isSpaceChar(c));
            return res.toString();
        }

        public boolean isSpaceChar(int c) {
            if (filter != null) return filter.isSpaceChar(c);
            return isWhitespace(c);
        }

        public static boolean isWhitespace(int c) {
            return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == -1;
        }

        public interface SpaceCharFilter {
            boolean isSpaceChar(int ch);
        }
    }
